Subject: Redwood demo — procurement & commercial path (post-call recap)

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

- What we heard: you need predictable latency for customer-facing embeddings (search/filter), SLOs around 100ms p50 token latency, and cost targets to keep unit economics steady as usage scales.
- Procurement readiness: you have procurement kickoff next week; primary questions are PO vs card and whether to purchase via AWS Marketplace.
- Legal: your team asked for standard T&Cs, insurance cert, and a W-9.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I can share the standard T&C + W-9 and a formal quote by EOD tomorrow (attached).
2) If you want to go via PO, can you confirm the procurement contact and timeline? If you prefer card/credit card, we can enable that quickly for pilot.
3) Logan will follow up on technical sizing and a short checklist for onboarding (KV caching + batching recommendations).

Attachments: Quote-ACME-20260512.pdf, Redwood-Standard-T&C-2026.pdf, W-9-Redwood.pdf

Appreciate a note on which commercial path (PO vs card vs marketplace) you want to pursue so we can surface the right flow.

Best,

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few follow-ups from procurement/ops side:

- Procurement prefers PO for anything over $25k annually. This will likely be a PO.
- Our procurement team will need: master services agreement (or T&C), invoice instructions, Redwood W-9, and insurance certificate.
- On marketplace: we typically prefer AWS Marketplace for faster procurement, but we need to understand pricing parity and billing cadence.

Procurement contact is Dana Miller (procurement@acme-corp.com). Our legal lead will likely want to review the T&C for a couple of redlines (data retention terms). I'll loop them in next week after the procurement kickoff if needed.

If you can get the T&C + W-9 and invoice instructions over, I'll start the internal ticket. Can you also confirm whether Redwood supports purchase via AWS Marketplace (and whether pricing is identical)?
